title: India Data Localization and Sharing Policy

sections.text: Dataset Y containing India resident data must be stored on servers physically located in India.
Sharing of India-sourced Dataset Y with international vendors is permitted provided the vendor maintains India-based data centers certified under CERT-In guidelines.
Vendor X is additionally restricted from receiving India-sourced Dataset Y under Vendor Restriction Policy VR-001, independent of the general data localization rules.
Where Indian data localization regulations conflict with the Global Data Sharing Policy, Indian regulations take precedence for India-sourced data.

source: Legal Compliance Register — India DPDP Framework 2025
